mapper.insert: insert into spas_coach_log(student_id, warning_id, intervene_id, knowledge_id, content, next_plan, create_by, create_time) values (#{studentId}, #{warningId}, #{interveneId}, #{knowledgeId}, #{content}, #{nextPlan}, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.delete: delete from spas_coach_log where log_id in #{id}
